prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1416; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving my sedan south on the main road in Pasadena, Texas, and had slowed to make a left turn into a parking lot. I checked the oncoming lanes, saw them clear, and began my turn. A vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the front passenger side of my car before I could complete the maneuver. The impact was hard enough to jolt my body forward and then back against the seat. I stopped my car right away, turned off the engine, and waited for emergency responders to arrive. Since the collision, I have had stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, along with headaches. I was evaluated at the scene and have since been seeing a doctor for treatment of what was diagnosed as whiplash. I am providing this account so the claim can be processed accurately.
